The '''cannon sled''' was a small ground vehicle used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Episode V">{{Film|V}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:EchoBaseHangar-CGSWG.png|thumb|left|180px|A cannon sled (left) next to several [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]].]]
During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] between the Rebel Alliance and the [[Galactic Empire]], several cannon sleds were present, with at least one on the front lines and another in a [[hangar]].<ref name="Episode V" />

Some of the craft had [[LC-10bW]] laser ice-cutters mounted to them and were used by the [[Alliance Corps of Engineers/Legends|Rebel Alliance Corps of Engineers]], alongside excavator machinery, to carve out space inside the caves of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]].<ref name="ITW:OT" />

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] manned such a craft inside Echo Base.<ref name="SW:BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CannonSled-TMOTESB.jpg|250px|thumb|Cannon sled prop on the set of ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]
The vehicle appeared, unnamed, in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. In the film, one is briefly visible in the left corner of the frame when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] rides into a hangar at the beginning of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']], and can be briefly glimpsed near the Rebel defenses outside of the base.<ref name="Episode V" />

The original blueprints for the prop show its production name was "cannon sled". The ''[[Star Wars: The Blueprints]]'' book indicates the vehicle was mounted on a sled towed by an [[Wikipedia:Snow Trac|Aktiv Fischer Snow Trac]] vehicle.<ref name="The Blueprints">''[[Star Wars: The Blueprints]]''</ref> On set footage of the vehicle was included in the rarely seen documentary by [[Michel Parbot]], ''[[The Making of "The Empire Strikes Back"]]''.<ref name="Parbot">{{YouTube|video=YeB-uXGGaEU|text=The "Lost" Empire Strikes Back Documentary by Michel Parbot (1980)|channel=channel/UCrGFZ8Ke27YWT8mfy2i0_NQ|name=Adywan revisited}}</ref> There were a number of publicity photos of [[Luke Skywalker]] manning a turret on the vehicle which, according to [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] executive [[Pablo Hidalgo]], were not deleted scenes but rather on-set photos taken with the prop.<ref name="Pablo tweet">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1432779261304258563|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=You may occasionally find photos of Luke in his snowspeeder pilot manning the guns online labeled as a 'deleted scene'. It's not. It's more like a photo opportunity, as this prop / vehicle was on set that day}}</ref>

The [[2005]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'' identifies the laser ice-cutter on top of the cannon sled,<ref name="ITW:OT" /> while [[2010]]'s ''[[Star Wars Blueprints: Rebel Edition]]'' refers to it as the LC-10bW.<ref name="Rebel Blueprints">''[[Star Wars Blueprints: Rebel Edition]]''</ref>

A vehicle resembling the cannon sled was featured in [[w:c:brickipedia:8083 Rebel Trooper Battle Pack|8083 Rebel Trooper Battle Pack]], a [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] battle pack that included several Hoth Rebel Troopers, along with dual flick firing rocket launchers. The vehicle was later added to the [[LEGO Star Wars: Microfighters (video game)|''LEGO Star Wars: Microfighters'' video game]].
